items.stem: How should retrieved document or web text be treated in an LLM application?

options.text: As untrusted data, kept separate from trusted instructions
options.rationale: Correct: untrusted content must not be treated as instructions.

options.text: As trusted instructions the model should always follow
options.rationale: Treating retrieved text as instructions enables injection.

options.text: As a replacement for all guardrails
options.rationale: Retrieved text does not replace guardrails.
